items.title: The Programming of Wizards
items.content_text: APL (A Programming Language) is an exceptionally unique language. It mainly follows an array paradigm, unlike the usual functional and object-oriented approaches; it depends heavily on weird mathematical glyphs; and it is surprisingly elegant.

items.title: VIM BRAIN
items.content_text: [An obscure little project](https://github.com/salastro/vimBrain) that I finished recently was to create an esoteric programming language. My goal was to achieve the smallest possible set of vim-like instructions while being Turing-complete.

items.title: A Linux dead simple guide!
items.content_text:
Introduction
 What is a Linux distribution 
Linux distributions usually refers to a family of operating systems that uses the Linux kernel and are similar in some design aspects. For the most part, Linux distributions follows the Unix philosophy and are Unix-like operating systems.
